purpose: Read only the exact retained configured-updater install-A.log to identify observed distribution paths matching the current source-admission private components.

exact_replacements.from: name: Inspect exact configured updater native diagnostics
exact_replacements.to: name: Inspect exact configured updater installation paths

exact_replacements.from: - name: Verify one exact public phase report archive and print bounded diagnostics
exact_replacements.to: - name: Verify the exact failed A installation log and print bounded private-component path matches

for name, raw in sorted(payloads.items()):
                  if name == 'native/install-A.log':
                      require(len(raw) == 713910 and sha256(raw).hexdigest() ==
                          '2b5daf4ee0b74fec0656cd4b3fdec7932d77da7863b7a3202b8d5fece4a41825',
                          'The exact installed A log bytes differ.')
                      encoding = 'utf-16' if raw.startswith((b'\xff\xfe', b'\xfe\xff')) else 'utf-8-sig'
                      lines = raw.decode(encoding).splitlines()
                      private = {'.venv', 'data', 'state', 'models', 'voices', 'references',
                          'voice-packages', 'dordiai-voices', 'node_modules', '.git', '.env'}
                      counts, matches, used, total_matches, destination_matches = {}, [], 0, 0, 0
                      for index, line in enumerate(lines):
                          parts = {part.strip("'\"").casefold() for part in line.replace('\\', '/').split('/')}
                          found = sorted(parts & private)
                          if not found:
                              continue
                          total_matches += 1
                          destination = 'dest filename:' in line.casefold()
                          destination_matches += int(destination)
                          for part in found:
                              counts[part] = counts.get(part, 0) + 1
                          entry = dict(line=index + 1, text=line[:1200],
                              private_components=found, destination_filename_line=destination)
                          cost = len(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True)) + 2
                          if len(matches) < 80 and used + cost <= 16000:
                              matches.append(entry)
                              used += cost
                      emit('INSTALLATION_PATH_COMPONENTS', dict(path=name, bytes=len(raw),
                          sha256=sha256(raw).hexdigest(), encoding=encoding, total_lines=len(lines),
                          source_components_git_blob='0f8b16912dcea56cf157f0d5d22a3afd6bef4960',
                          fixed_private_components=sorted(private), matching_lines=total_matches,
                          destination_filename_matches=destination_matches, component_line_counts=counts,
                          selected_lines=matches, complete=len(matches) == total_matches,
                          boundary='Read-only literal path-component matches in the exact original installer log; no source admission is changed and no update outcome is qualified.'))
                      continue
